scope: Directly evidenced Hodgson-linked transfers of Nepal/Himalayan paper pulp or paper stuff, separating material state, package state, route, custody and experiment relation.
central_claim: Paper pulp reached experimental sites through material logistics histories that must be reconstructed separately from the later manufacturing tests. The March 1842 shipment is directly documented as twenty-four packages moving from Nepal toward Calcutta through a cost-sensitive land/water forwarding system; its direct consignment relation to the Serampore machine trial remains unproven.
